content:
These clearly don't match. Cutting_Weevil shows stripped shoots, Sooty_Mould shows black encrustation, and Powdery_Mildew shows white powdery coating.

The test image shows a green mango leaf with small, round brown spots/galls, some of which have fallen out leaving shot holes. This matches the Gall_Midge reference images very closely — both show scattered round raised lesions on otherwise green leaves with characteristic holes where galls have dropped out.

```json
{"prediction": "Gall_Midge", "confidence": 0.88, "reasoning": "The test leaf shows small round brown gall-like spots scattered across the leaf surface, with some having fallen out to leave characteristic shot holes. This matches the Gall_Midge symptom description (round blister-shaped galls ~2-3mm, shot holes when galls fall out) and closely resembles the Gall_Midge reference images."}
```
